toolbar.$description: Toolbar: a bar of commands on the bar color, its controls sized by the density tokens.

button.$description: A button on the toolbar that is given no variant or size (neither its own nor the toolbar's): its variant and size, and the look of a toggle that is on.

more.$description: The "more" button the items that do not fit go into: an icon without the menu arrow.

bar.$description: The bar (`vertical`: a column of controls).

separator.$description: The line between groups: across a row (`width` its thickness, `margin-block` how far it stays from the ends), `vertical` across a column.
